name: Bigfoot Internet
summary: National dialup ISP ('100% Australian owned', by 2001; bought Blast & Hotlinks ISPs; 70+ POPs); brand absorbed into Eftel (bigfoot.com.au rebranded to EFTel early 2005).

events.details: Dialup, 70+ POPs; earliest substantive Wayback capture of bigfoot.com.au 25 Sep 2001 ('Welcome to Bigfoot Internet').
Brand absorbed into Eftel: bigfoot.com.au was still Bigfoot-branded ('100% Australian owned') on 9 Jan 2005 but EFTel-branded by 30 Mar 2005.
